Egedal is a Danish municipality whose healthcare data is tracked in the national clinical quality reporting for atrial fibrillation treatment. It is specifically mentioned in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The report benchmarks clinical quality across all 98 Danish municipalities using data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. Egedal's data is included in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant treatment among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. In the report's municipal breakdown, Egedal's specific performance metrics for this indicator are documented to support local quality development and healthcare benchmarking [^src1]. 

As Egedal is only mentioned once in the provided corpus within a statistical table, no further relationships, claims, or timeline events are available.
